scripts.sync:we: npm run build && powershell -Command "Copy-Item -Path 'dist\*' -Destination 'C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\wallpaper_engine\projects\myprojects\nagomi_koi\' -Recurse -Force; $wp = Get-Process -Name wallpaper64, wallpaper32 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($wp) { Start-Process 'C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\wallpaper_engine\wallpaper64.exe' -ArgumentList '-control', 'openWallpaper', '-file', 'C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\wallpaper_engine\projects\myprojects\nagomi_koi\project.json' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Write-Host 'Wallpaper Engine synced successfully!'"
scripts.sync:lively: npm run build && powershell -Command "$livelyDir = 'C:\Users\triet\AppData\Local\Packages\12030rocksdanister.LivelyWallpaper_97hta09mmv6hy\LocalCache\Local\Lively Wallpaper\Library\wallpapers\nagomi_koi_pond'; if (Test-Path $livelyDir) { Copy-Item -Path 'dist\*' -Destination $livelyDir -Recurse -Force }; if (Test-Path 'NagomiKoi.zip') { Remove-Item 'NagomiKoi.zip' -Force }; if (Test-Path 'NagomiKoi.livelypack') { Remove-Item 'NagomiKoi.livelypack' -Force }; Compress-Archive -Path 'dist\*' -DestinationPath 'NagomiKoi.zip' -Force; Move-Item -Path 'NagomiKoi.zip' -Destination 'NagomiKoi.livelypack' -Force; Write-Host 'Lively Wallpaper synced and NagomiKoi.livelypack updated successfully!'"
scripts.sync:all: npm run sync:we && npm run sync:lively
